Cloud Me API: read-only, authenticated read path to the owner's private cloud-me-* repos. The service holds one READ-ONLY deploy key per repo server-side, keeps a shallow clone of each declared repo, and serves declared JSON datasets (and filtered config files) to fleet apps, so no app holds a GitHub credential (#1079). First consumer: the cloud-webapps c3-* sites (#1063).

MCP + HTTP faces over the Android constellation's on-device debug API (libs:devtools AppDebugServer, behind the SuperApp mesh gateway), reached over ssh. lib-api/lib-mcp shared, one module per app under mcps-apps/, one server process.
Mail MCP server — IMAP/SMTP/Admin via Stalwart REST API
Drive MCP server — one facade over every storage unit: repos, files, photos, sync, scrapes, S3 and conversion

Git Proxy API — Authelia-fronted read path to GitHub so the phone holds NO GitHub credential (#647, route 3 of #646's fallback chain). The caller authenticates to US with the Authelia bearer it already has; this service holds the GitHub token server-side and streams the result back.

Google Apps Script – Google Personal — serverless Apps Script project backing the google-personal-mcp integration (Gmail for personal Google accounts, multi-account). Runs on Google's Apps Script runtime (V8/JavaScript) — no container is shipped.

Runs on Google's Apps Script runtime (V8/JavaScript) — no container is shipped.
Google Personal Account MCP server — Gmail (IMAP/SMTP via App Password) for personal Google accounts, multi-account
Google Workspace MCP server — Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets via HTTP transport

my-ai API on oci-apps — one polyglot container: OpenAI /v1 + Ollama /api + Anthropic /v1/messages mimic backed by OpenRouter (no Claude subscription, no metered Anthropic key), with a vendored Headroom (Apache-2.0) compression hop and a savings dashboard. Sibling of claude-superset-api; the agent face for this stack is goose (my-ai wraps goose, claude-superset keeps claude-cli). Internal WG-only sidecar, never public.

Claude superset API on oci-apps — one polyglot container: OpenAI /v1 + Ollama /api + Anthropic /v1/messages mimic backed by the subscription `claude` CLI (no metered key), with a vendored Headroom (Apache-2.0) compression hop and a savings dashboard. Successor to kg-bridge; usable as a local/remote fallback. Internal WG-only sidecar, never public.

Central SQLite store of all Claude Code session transcripts — push/list/fetch so a session started on one device can be resumed from any other. WG-only sidecar on oci-apps; Node 22 built-in node:sqlite (phone-portable, no native deps).

Nous Research Hermes Agent (autonomous, persistent-memory AI agent) on oci-apps. Messaging gateway (Telegram live, Mattermost scaffolded) backed by claude-superset-api (subscription CLI, no metered key). WG-internal, never public.

OpenClaw (MIT, github.com/openclaw/openclaw) on oci-apps — the open-source personal agent gateway, as a fourth fleet agent next to hermes, goose and claude. Upstream's own image, unmodified. Its gateway listens on 127.0.0.1 only (host network, auth mode none, the documented trusted-loopback setup) with the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions enabled; the fleet reaches it ONLY through the agent gateway my-ai-api (X-Agent-Mode: openclaw). Its model calls go back through that same gateway's OpenRouter face, which holds the key, so this service has no secret at all. Never public, never on the mesh directly.
Mattermost team chat (TE 11.x ESR) with ntfy bridge and C3 command bot
Cloud Webmail — Stalwart-native JMAP webmail with multi-account/multi-server (webmail.diegonmarcos.com); OUR build of bulwarkmail/webmail 1.9.2. Replaces SnappyMail.
